reason: Plain GF(256) Shamir secret sharing. splitSecret + combineShares + Share type. AES Rijndael field (irreducible polynomial 0x11b), log/antilog tables built once at module load, generator 0x03. Byte-parallel splitting — each byte of the secret gets its own polynomial of degree M-1 with the secret byte as constant term and freshly random coefficients via the internal CSPRNG. Combine uses Lagrange interpolation at x=0 over any M-or-more shares; extra shares beyond threshold tolerated (over-determined but consistent). Rejection paths for M<2, N<M, N>255, empty secret, duplicate indices, mismatched lengths, index 0.
